findings.detail: run_variant() discards the results returned by checked() for successful git apply commands. Their stdout, stderr and exits are absent from results.json, so a maintainer investigating a successful apply warning cannot retrieve the promised evidence. The runner reference similarly overstates coverage with “all step evidence.”
findings.fix: Rewrite the reason as: “Python runner retains setup/check stdout, stderr and exits in JSON; patch-command failures are retained in the failure cause.” In plugins/plant-defects/skills/plant-defects/references/checked-runner.md, qualify “exact step exits” and “all step evidence” as setup/check evidence, then regenerate the mirror.
findings.title: Uncited: The diagnostic-retention claim includes subprocess results that are discarded.

strengths: The reference clearly explains script trust requirements and private-copy isolation.
The unittest example distinguishes assertion failures from skips and framework errors.
The regular-file capture comment explains the process-handling rationale.
summary: Reviewed all 24 membership paths and cross-checked changed comments and documentation against the implementation and tests. One documentation suggestion remains; no Important or Critical comment defects were found. Review was static and read-only; tests were not run.
